upgrading: A beta: a pre-release to try before v0.12.1. `upgrade` and the console's version chip never offer it and a fresh install never lands on it; reach it with `run.py upgrade --to v0.12.1-beta`. v0.12.1 will be an ordinary upgrade from it.

The portfolio tab's direction card has an ideas button: what drives your delta and the rolls that would move it either way without closing anything. A poor man's covered call is rolled under its own PMCC rules.
The PMCC tab lists PMCCs and undecided candidates only. A call calendar or diagonal that is not a PMCC is named in one line that opens the positions tab's new time spreads filter.
The wheel tab opens on active cycles, with open, waiting, complete and all one click away. The wheel and PMCC tabs switch between cards and rows.
The manage snapshot reads a few more broker chains (each put calendar's next expiries), inside the existing manage.roll_out cap.

config_changes.note: New and optional: the direction card's ideas (front_days, roll_short_delta, untested_short_delta, min_credit, new_spread). The defaults apply when it is absent.

upgrading: This is the first release with `run.py upgrade`. Moving from v0.11.x to v0.12.0 is manual (docs/guide/upgrading.md); from here on `upgrade` does it.

Earnings is paper-only: it cannot place orders, and a leftover `enable_live_trading` or `live` key does nothing. The manual desk and the QuikOptions integration are removed. Live orders now exist only in MEIC, flies and bwb.

flies, curve, pmcc and bwb ship switched off in the example configs. Your config is never rewritten, so a module you have on stays on until you switch it off. `/live-flies-start` and `/live-bwb-start` refuse while their module is off.
The arm gates new MEIC condors only: an unarmed `meic-live` still manages what it holds. MEIC live entries are one contract.
The scheduler merged daily jobs that run at several times into one job each, so 18 job ids leave `status`. Restart the supervisor after the upgrade.
The installer now sets up Dolt unless told not to (`-SkipDolt`) and runs `run.py bootstrap` at the end (`-SkipBootstrap` skips it). `-WithDesk` is accepted and ignored.
The console checks GitHub for a newer release at most every six hours; `update_check: false` in console.json turns that off.

morning-data and evening-data are two pipelines that replace 28 jobs in `status`; a failed landing step now stops the steps that read it, and per-step results are in state/pipeline.<name>.json. manage waits 60 seconds after a fill, takes no snapshot within 2 minutes of the last, and posts only when its action list changes.
manual_steps: Stop the suite (uninstall.cmd or ./uninstall.sh), get v0.12.0 (unzip into a new folder, never over the old one, or fetch tags and check out the tag), and run the installer again.

Run `python run.py doctor` and delete what it says is ignored: the earnings `enable_live_trading` or `live` key, the `quikoptions` and `desk_notify` blocks in config.json, and ~/.cherrypick/config/desk.json.
Switch off any retired module you still have on (`modules.<name>.enabled` false for flies, curve, pmcc and bwb).
Run `python run.py supervise --restart`, then restart any resident job, then `python run.py status` to see the two data pipelines.

Removed with the integration; ignored. Reports of your own use the new `external_reports` list.
Removed with the manual desk; ignored. ~/.cherrypick/config/desk.json is ignored too.

New. Set false to stop the console asking GitHub for the latest release.
An arm the config does not declare stays off (control excepted) from 2026-10-30.

measurement_boundaries: 2026-11-03, all modules: the supervisor and its jobs are opted out of Windows power throttling, so tick timing, quote age and stop latency either side are not poolable.

Screeners: 2026-10-27 only names whose monthly options are confirmed liquid are listed.
curve 2026-10-30 (undeclared arms off); pmcc and bwb entries off 2026-11-08; flies retired 2026-10-19.

upgrading: An ordinary upgrade from v0.12.0 or the v0.12.1 beta, which this release includes: run `python run.py upgrade`, then `python run.py supervise --restart`, restart any resident job and restart the console.

The suite can read a second broker login beside the first (`broker.logins`, `streamer.instances`, MEIC `live_accounts`). It is off until you add one; Live gains an account select when there is more than one account.

manage's rules carry an evidence grade (mechanics, tested, contested, practice, ours) in place of a confidence number, and ties between rules follow a fixed order. A leftover `confidence`, `hold` or `conflict_penalty` in manage.json is reported as unknown and ignored.
A cash account or IRA is held to its own buying-power caps (80% total, 65% short puts and shares, 35% spreads, and a -20% stress line) instead of the VIX table. Margin accounts keep the table.

manage learned covered calls, wheel puts by intent, the super bull and bear, and a directional time exit (off by default); a diagonal's target is capped at 75% of its modelled gain, the PMCC long rolls at 60 days left and `short_term_short_days` is 21.
Earnings times come from Yahoo's calendar for any date Nasdaq's does not answer.
A new package, `packages/ensemble`, holds a rules engine for short-dated option arms. It is paper-only, has no loop yet and nothing in it is switched on.
manual_steps: Run `python run.py supervise --restart`, then restart any resident job (a job reads its config only when it starts) and restart the console.

config_changes.note: Removed. Each rule has an `evidence` grade instead; the old keys are reported as unknown and ignored.
New on every rule block (mechanics, tested, contested, practice or ours), also inside a shape's own override.
New: the cash account and IRA caps (max_pct_nlv 0.8, stock_exposure_pct_nlv 0.65, spread_risk_pct_nlv 0.35, stress). `enabled: false` restores the VIX table for a cash account.
New, off by default: the 21-day exit for directional trades.
New: judges an in-the-money covered call by its call-away.
New: a diagonal's target is the lesser of its take-profit and 75% of its modelled gain.
Default 120 becomes 60. A value you set is kept.
Default 14 becomes 21. A value you set is kept.
New, on: legs all opened three days or fewer before expiry close on the expiry day.
`wheel` and `no_wheel` are accepted values; Config > Position rules > Intents edits them.
New and optional, default []: further broker logins, each with its own keyring entry.
New and optional, default []: one producer per further login.
New and optional, default {}: a full live block per further login. Off until its own gate, enable and arm are set.
The example gains an XSP entry beside QQQ and NDX.
